mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5pp over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 1% YoY and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6%, it signals a supply-driven economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive, or Rank IC > -0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and rising by more than 0.5pp over 3 months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real estate loans (RSAFS) grow by more than 10% YoY and housing starts (HOUST) also rise by more than 5% YoY, it signals a housing-driven demand boom that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS YoY growth > 10% and HOUST YoY growth > 5%
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) declines by more than 100,000 jobs over 3 months and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, it signals a labor market downturn that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines > 100,000 in 3 months and UNRATE rising
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 3% YoY and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3%, it signals a high-inflation environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive, or Rank IC > -0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) grows by more than 5% YoY and the ISM manufacturing PMI is above 60, it signals a strong supply-side expansion that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO YoY growth > 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
